topic: Analytics design improvements for assets and facilities
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on requested improvements to the analytics interface. Specifically, someone asked if it was possible to delete both assets and facilities within the new design, noting they could not find such a button.

[me] suggested that simply adding a delete button would be insufficient; rather, the facility and asset management should be grouped together with inventory for better organization.

Someone confirmed this requirement.
decisions: The analytics interface needs grouping of facility and asset management with inventory.
action_items: Implement functionality to allow deletion of assets and facilities in the new design.
Group facility and asset management alongside inventory in the analytics UI.
